name: 57-vitest-wildcard-single-char
title: Support `?` in wildcard patterns
body: wildcardPatternToRegExp only understood `*`. This adds `?` as a single-character wildcard, splitting on it before escaping the literal parts, and documents the supported syntax.

bugs.why: The trailing `$` anchor was dropped, so patterns now match any string that merely starts with the pattern (e.g. 'foo' matches 'foobar').
